cases.question: What is the maximum reimbursement for hotel accommodation in India?
cases.source_text: Seaview Shipping Ltd - Business Travel and Expenses Policy (2026) 1. Approval All business travel must be approved in advance by the line manager. International travel also requires approval from the department head. 2. Flights Employees travel in economy class. Business class is allowed only for flights longer than 8 hours, with department head approval. 3. Hotels and meals Hotel accommodation is reimbursed up to INR 6,000 per night in India and up to USD 180 per night abroad. A daily meal allowance of INR 1,200 (or USD 45 abroad) is paid for each full travel day.

cases.question: What is the deadline for submitting annual leave requests?
cases.source_text: Seaview Shipping Ltd - Leave Policy for Shore Staff (version 3, 2026) This policy applies to all permanent shore-based employees. Crew on board vessels are covered by the Seafarers Employment Agreement instead. 1. Annual leave Shore staff are entitled to 24 working days of paid annual leave per calendar year. New joiners receive leave pro rata, accruing 2 days for each completed month of service. Up to 5 unused annual leave days may be carried forward into the next year. Carried-forward days must be used by 31 March or they lapse. Annual leave requests must be submitted in the HR portal at least 10 working days in advance and approved by the line manager. 2. Sick leave Employees receive 12 days of paid sick leave per calendar year. A medical certificate is required for any absence longer than 2 consecutive working days. Unused sick leave cannot be carried forward and is not paid out on leaving.

cases.question: What is the maximum amount for gifts that must be declared to the compliance team?
cases.source_text: # Seaview Shipping Ltd - Code of Conduct (Shore Staff) ## Working hours Standard office hours are 09:00 to 18:00, Monday to Friday, with a one-hour lunch break. Flexible start times between 08:00 and 10:00 are allowed with line manager agreement. ## Remote work Employees may work from home up to 2 days per week after completing 6 months of service, if their role allows it and their manager agrees. ## Gifts and hospitality Gifts from suppliers or customers worth more than INR 5,000 must be declared to the compliance team within 7 days. Cash gifts must never be accepted. ## Conflicts of interest Employees must declare any personal or financial interest in a supplier, customer or competitor to the compliance team before taking part in related decisions. ## Reporting concerns Concerns about misconduct can be reported to the line manager, to HR, or anonymously through the ethics hotline. Retaliation against anyone who reports a concern in good faith is a disciplinary offence. ## Dress code Business casual dress is expected in the office. Safety shoes and helmets are mandatory when visiting vessels or the port.
